REPO="ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform"

import json, sys

for RUN_ID in 31904919394 31904919417 31904919375 31904919374; do

import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
if 'message' in d and 'Not Found' in d.get('message', ''):
    print('Run not found')
else:
    print('name:', d.get('name'))
    print('status:', d.get('status'))
    print('conclusion:', d.get('conclusion'))

import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
ent = d.get('enterprise', {})
spec = d.get('specialists', {})
print(f'phase: {ent.get(\"phase\")}')
print(f'running: {ent.get(\"running\")}, queued: {ent.get(\"queued\")}, failed: {ent.get(\"failed\")}, blocked: {ent.get(\"blocked\")}')
print(f'specialists: {spec.get(\"verified\")}/{spec.get(\"total\")} verified')
"
else
    echo "No owner token available"
fi
